The Toughpower PT 1200W Platinum is ATX 3.1 compatible, 80 PLUS Platinum certified, and supports native PCIe Gen 5.1 (12+4pin) for next-gen GPU power. Delivers 1200W continuous output at 40°C.
It features 100% Japanese capacitors, a strong single +12V rail, an ultra-quiet 135mm hydraulic bearing fan, and a Zero Cable Platform with low-profile modular cables.

Long-Term Durability with Premium Components
Built with 100% high-quality Japanese 105°C electrolytic capacitors, the unit ensures long-term stability and durability, even under high
temperatures and continuous heavy loads.
Next-Gen Ready Power
Toughpower PT 1200W delivers reliable, high-efficiency output with Intel ATX 3.1 and PCIe Gen 5.1 (12V-2x6) support. Its robust +12V rail and
advanced DC-DC & LLC design ensure next-gen stability and precise power delivery.
Full Modular Layout with Optimized Airflow
Features a fully modular design with low-profile etched black cables for easy installation, better airflow, and a cleaner build.
Built for Intel ATX 3.1 Standard
The Toughpower PT 1200W Platinum fully complies with Intel ATX 3.1 specifications, supporting Intel C6/C7 low power states and ErP readiness
for enhanced energy efficiency. It delivers reliable 1200W continuous power at 40°C, meeting strict power timing standards to ensure system
stability and compatibility with modern PC builds.

A 135mm hydraulic bearing fan delivers quiet, efficient cooling even under load. With fully modular low-profile cables and a Zero Cable

Enhanced +12V Rail and Superior Circuit Design
The Toughpower PT 1200W Platinum delivers stable 1200W power via a strong single +12V rail. Its advanced DC-DC and LLC circuitry ensure
precise voltage regulation and high efficiency.
